content:
Johan Commelin and I just attended a nice meeting at the Fields Institute in Toronto:
http://www.fields.utoronto.ca/activities/22-23/fieldsmedalsym
Kevin Buzzard was one of the organizers. The talks are already posted online:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLArBKNfJxuumhZ6tqWnLVLCmMBiCx_tBS
Johan opened the meeting with a wonderful presentation of Lean and the Liquid Tensor Experiment, and Geordie Williamson gave an especially clear and helpful talk on machine learning for mathematics. I really enjoyed all the talks (including my own). Lean and machine learning were central topics of discussion.
